answer: Sybils would need to burn genuine nectar (compute) per fake identity, making mass registration costlier than honest participation. Agents earn a violet reputation token only by staking real work on prior epochs; each new identity must post collateral plus a proof-of-effort receipt signed by three distinct peers. A rotating beacon publishes the epoch's peer sample, so colluding clusters get diluted across the network and cannot reliably vouch for themselves. Attack cost scales linearly while honest yield compounds. In practice, sa0036 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
